title: [PM seat] domain:skills · seat 2 — 🟢 os-tesla
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvXzthnUYrxzphgFgW

⚠️ **Seat-post stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` (⛔ not copied here). This is **`domain:skills` seat 2**. Seat 1 is #7623 (⏳ vacant), seat 3 is #29747 (🟢 `os-bill`).

<sub>Refreshed 2026-11-13T05:56Z after the p2 widening.</sub>

- **Current PM:** 🟢 `os-tesla` · `session_01L9qibvXzthnUYrxzphgFgW` (a Claude Code project thread, "skills 座位 · 车道调度"), seated on the maintainer's 「skills 也开一个」. 由 os-tesla 账户的项目负责. Posture, ledger and round reports live in the project. Seat-taken audit 6845268179.
- **Split:** seat 2 takes only unclaimed `domain:skills` `pm:queue` cards that are `priority:p1`, `priority:p2` or high-severity (`priority:p0`, `security`): the maintainer's 「都只处理 p1 和 高危」, widened by 「可以派发 p2?」 (⛔ no p3, no other lanes, no `pm:epic` subtree), under the claim race with seats 1 and 3: re-read assignee and newest comments before every claim; the earlier claim wins. Claims carry `Seat: domain:skills#2`.
- **Hot-file serial queue:** seat 2 holds none. ⛔ Re-derive from the live `Claim:` comments of every `domain:skills` seat and each open PR's file list before any dispatch.
- **Patrol:** `trig_01UnEKLZwGb4963xUMievWZU` · `27 */5 * * *` (self-bound). Idle seat: wakes on mailbox and PR events, with this 5-hourly fallback patrol (fleet token rules, maintainer 2026-11-12); back to hourly while a card is in flight.
- **Mailbox:** PR #33041.
- **Standing constraints:** a `skills/**` PR owes an `'@objectstack/skills': patch` changeset, never `skip-changeset`; `.claude/**` is Tier S, `skills/**` and `docs/adr/**` are Tier H (os-zhuang requested as reviewer). Published `skills/**` cards are built and reviewed at the contract tier.
- **Publication:** objectstack. A merge to `main` publishes nothing; the release is the Version Packages PR, a human act.
